conclusion: The cited MISEV2023 consensus (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports the high-level requirements stated in the reviewers' conclusions (need for orthogonal characterization, defined source-cell controls, validated release/stability/potency assays, and careful separation from non-vesicular material). However, the supplied evidence set contains only this guideline and no program-specific CMC/analytical data; therefore the reviewers' program-readiness assertions (that SGL-001 has or has not met the listed CMC/analytics criteria) cannot be verified. Program-specific CMC documents and assay validation packages are required to confirm readiness to advance formulation or to perform cross-species bridging studies.
unsupported_assertions: Any assertion that program-specific MCB/WCB creation and characterization reports exist and are sufficient (no MCB/WCB documentation provided).
Any assertion that three GMP-like scale-up batch records with release data and batch comparability analysis exist (no batch records or comparability data provided).
Any assertion that orthogonal intact-EV QC assays are validated (LLOQ, specificity, precision) for this program (no validation reports provided).
Any assertion that a validated, stability-indicating potency assay linked to an in vivo PD endpoint exists for SGL-001 (no potency validation or linkage data provided).

Any assertion that formulation/device compatibility and intact-EV recovery (ex vivo or in vivo controls) have been demonstrated for the intranasal formulation (no compatibility/recovery studies provided).

Any claim that rodent intranasal biodistribution data alone are sufficient to predict intact-EV CNS exposure in larger species without orthogonal intact-EV analytics and bridging controls (MISEV supports the opposite; program lacks the required orthogonal in vivo analytics).

Any conclusion that lot-to-lot comparability, scalable reproducible manufacturing, or release/stability/potency reproducibility has been demonstrated for SGL-001 (no process characterization or reproducibility data provided).

Any claim that orthogonal intact-EV analytics were applied to in vivo samples (rodent or large-animal) and showed signals correspond to intact vesicles for this program (no such in vivo analytic data provided).
